overview_description: Create, read, update and delete the alert responsibilities that say who handles alerts.
intro: Alert responsibilities say who handles which alerts. You can list, create, read, update and delete them on the singular `/alert_responsibility` path. This area has 5 endpoints, and all seven SDKs call every one.
notes: **The path is singular.** Use `/alert_responsibility`. The `href` and `url` values in these records say `/alert_responsibilities`, a path not served at the top level.
**Writes are wrapped in `alert_responsibility`.** `name` is required and unique; a create reads only `name`, `display_name` and `description`.
**Reads take the `ar_` id or the raw uuid; the delete takes the `ar_` id only.**
**These are the same records as Alert responsibility settings.** `/settings/alert_responsibilities` serves them too.
**In the SDKs this area is `alert_responsibility` (singular).** `alert_responsibilities` is the Alert responsibility settings area.
**Listings page by cursor.** Records sit under `data`; pass `pagination.next_cursor` as `cursor` to read the next page, and stop when `pagination.has_more` is `false`.

endpoints.title: List alert responsibilities
endpoints.summary: Lists the alert responsibilities on your instance, one page at a time.
endpoints.description: Returns a page of alert responsibilities under `data`, with cursor `pagination`. The path is singular. Other fields filter as `filter_<field>` for equality or `filter_<field>_<operator>`, such as `filter_created_on_gte`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The most records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `pagination.next_cursor` of the previous page, to read the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: A field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` for descending order, such as `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an alert responsibility
endpoints.summary: Retrieves one alert responsibility by its `ar_` id or its raw uuid.
endpoints.description: Returns the alert responsibility under `alert_responsibility`. A deleted one returns `404`.

parameters.name: alert_responsibility_id
parameters.description: The alert responsibility's `ar_` id, or its raw uuid.

404.description: No alert responsibility has that id, or it is deleted.

endpoints.title: Create an alert responsibility
endpoints.summary: Creates an alert responsibility and returns it.
endpoints.description: Send the record wrapped in `alert_responsibility`. `name` is required and must be unique; `display_name` and `description` are the only other keys read. The new record comes back under `alert_responsibility`, with its `activity_logs`.

name.description: The responsibility's name. Must be unique.

endpoints.title: Update an alert responsibility
endpoints.summary: Changes an alert responsibility and returns it.
endpoints.description: Send the fields to change wrapped in `alert_responsibility`: `name`, `display_name`, `description`, and `status`, which moves between `active` and `inactive`.

parameters.name: alert_responsibility_id
parameters.description: The alert responsibility's `ar_` id, or its raw uuid.

alert_responsibility.description: Alerts about failed billing and refunds.
Alerts about failed billing and refunds.

endpoints.title: Delete an alert responsibility
endpoints.summary: Deletes an alert responsibility. Nothing comes back.
endpoints.description: Returns `204` with no body. The delete is soft, and a read afterwards returns `404`. Name the record by its `ar_` id; the raw uuid is not accepted here.

href.description: Points at `/alert_responsibilities`, a path not served at the top level.

activity_logs.description: Present on the create response only.

url.description: The path this page was read from.

limit.description: The page size applied to this page.

has_more.description: Whether another page follows. Trust this over `next_cursor`, which can still be set on the last page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to read the next page.
